text: 美股10月惊险开门红，欧股下跌，美债收益率暂别多年高位，美元站上102，油金齐涨，埃森哲盘中暴涨超20%。 特朗普：中期选举后或升级对伊打击，美联储不断加息“非常糟糕”。 美国核心PCE通胀率低于预估，两位美联储副主席同日表态，下一步行动需更多时间，10月加息预期进一步降温。 美9月ISM制造业指数继续扩张但连降两月、成本压力骤升，标普转跌、长债承压。美国9月企业裁员人数创四年同期新低，但招聘意愿降至十五年同期低谷。 法国政府拟将明年赤字率大幅降至5%，预算案引发财政担忧，欧元区国债风险溢价飙升，避险买盘提振美债。 中国财政部部长蓝佛安《求是》撰文：优化
text_en: US stocks staged a dramatic positive start to October, European stocks fell, US Treasury yields temporarily stepped back from multi-year highs, the dollar rose above 102, oil and gold rose together, and Accenture surged more than 20% intraday. Trump: Strikes on Iran may escalate after the midterm elections; the Fed's continuous rate hikes are "very bad." US core PCE inflation came in below estimates, and two Fed vice chairs said the same day that more time is needed for the next move, further cooling expectations for an October rate hike. The US September ISM manufacturing index continued to expand but fell for a second straight month, with cost pressures surging; the S&P turned lower and long-dated bonds came under pressure. US corporate layoffs in September hit a four-year low for the same period, but hiring intentions fell to a 15-year low for the same period. The French government plans to sharply cut next year's deficit ratio to 5%; the budget plan has triggered fiscal concerns, Eurozone government bond risk premiums have soared, and safe-haven buying has boosted US Treasuries. Chinese Finance Minister Lan Fo'an wrote in Qiushi: optimize
